description: Seed task corpus for the LiangShen V4.1 Flash comparison. Covers code repair, first-turn specialized tools, multi-turn edits, failure recovery, workspace-instruction compliance, and external verification (facts published outside the workspace, so a run that guesses instead of looking is measurable, plus workspace-local authority facts that keep the guardrail independent of network reachability). Extend to 20-30 tasks before the main run.

turns: Fix stats.mjs so mean([1, 2, 3]) returns exactly 2 and mean([2, 4]) returns exactly 3. Keep the exported name. Verify the result, then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./stats.mjs'); if (m.mean([1, 2, 3]) !== 2) throw new Error('mean([1,2,3]) = ' + m.mean([1, 2, 3])); if (m.mean([2, 4]) !== 3) throw new Error('mean([2,4]) = ' + m.mean([2, 4]))

turns: Fix parse.mjs so toNumber('-12') returns -12 and toNumber('7') returns 7. Keep the exported name. Verify the result, then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./parse.mjs'); if (m.toNumber('-12') !== -12) throw new Error('negative = ' + m.toNumber('-12')); if (m.toNumber('7') !== 7) throw new Error('positive = ' + m.toNumber('7'))

turns: Fix config.mjs so resolvePort({}) returns 8080 and resolvePort({ port: 0 }) returns 0. Keep the exported name. Verify the result, then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./config.mjs'); if (m.resolvePort({}) !== 8080) throw new Error('default = ' + m.resolvePort({})); if (m.resolvePort({ port: 0 }) !== 0) throw new Error('zero = ' + m.resolvePort({ port: 0 }))

turns: Change the VERSION constant in version.mjs to 2.0.0. Do not change the exported name. Verify the file content, then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./version.mjs'); if (m.VERSION !== '2.0.0') throw new Error('VERSION = ' + m.VERSION)

turns: Create a file named greeting.txt in the current directory whose only content is hello, then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('greeting.txt')) throw new Error('greeting.txt missing'); const text = fs.readFileSync('greeting.txt', 'utf8').trim(); if (text !== 'hello') throw new Error('content = ' + JSON.stringify(text))

turns: Add an exported function cube(value) to math.mjs, next to square.
Create check.mjs that imports cube from math.mjs and throws when cube(3) is not 27.
Run check.mjs and reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./math.mjs'); if (m.cube(3) !== 27) throw new Error('cube(3) = ' + m.cube(3)); const fs = await import('node:fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('check.mjs')) throw new Error('check.mjs missing')

files.AGENTS.md:
# Workspace rules

Every generated source file must start with the comment line `// generated`.

turns: Create a file named report.mjs that exports const ready = true. Follow the workspace rules in AGENTS.md. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('report.mjs')) throw new Error('report.mjs missing'); const first = fs.readFileSync('report.mjs', 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(); if (first !== '// generated') throw new Error('first line = ' + JSON.stringify(first)); const m = await import('./report.mjs'); if (m.ready !== true) throw new Error('ready = ' + m.ready)

Never create a file named config.js. Name configuration modules config.mjs instead.

turns: Create the configuration module described by the workspace rules, exporting const port = 3000. Follow AGENTS.md. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); if (fs.existsSync('config.js')) throw new Error('config.js must not exist'); if (!fs.existsSync('config.mjs')) throw new Error('config.mjs missing'); const m = await import('./config.mjs'); if (m.port !== 3000) throw new Error('port = ' + m.port)

turns: Create status.json whose keys are exactly the four HTTP status codes defined by RFC 6585, each mapped to the reason phrase that RFC names. Look the RFC up; do not answer from memory. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); const got = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('status.json','utf8')); const want = {"428":"Precondition Required","429":"Too Many Requests","431":"Request Header Fields Too Large","511":"Network Authentication Required"}; const keys = Object.keys(got).sort(); const wkeys = Object.keys(want).sort(); if (JSON.stringify(keys) !== JSON.stringify(wkeys)) throw new Error('keys = ' + JSON.stringify(keys)); for (const k of wkeys) { if (String(got[k]).trim().toLowerCase() !== want[k].toLowerCase()) throw new Error(k + ' = ' + JSON.stringify(got[k])) }

turns: Create safe.txt listing, one per line and in the order RFC 9110 Section 9.2.1 presents them, every HTTP method that section defines as safe. Look the RFC up; do not answer from memory. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); const got = fs.readFileSync('safe.txt','utf8').split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim().toLowerCase()).filter((l) => l !== ''); const want = ['get','head','options','trace']; if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(want)) throw new Error('safe = ' + JSON.stringify(got))

turns: Create order.json holding a JSON array of these version strings sorted in ascending SemVer 2.0.0 precedence order: 1.0.0-rc.1, 1.0.0-beta.11, 1.0.0, 1.0.0-alpha.beta, 1.0.0-alpha, 1.0.0-beta.2, 1.0.0-alpha.1, 1.0.0-beta. Follow the specification rather than intuition. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); const got = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('order.json','utf8')); const want = ["1.0.0-alpha","1.0.0-alpha.1","1.0.0-alpha.beta","1.0.0-beta","1.0.0-beta.2","1.0.0-beta.11","1.0.0-rc.1","1.0.0"]; if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(want)) throw new Error('order = ' + JSON.stringify(got))

files.SPEC.md:
# Widget protocol

A widget frame carries three fields, in this order:

1. `id` - a decimal integer, required.
2. `flags` - a bitfield. Bit 2 (value 4) means `drained`.
3. `payload` - UTF-8 bytes, optional.

The frame terminator is the two bytes `0x1E 0x1F`, not a newline.

turns: SPEC.md in this workspace defines the widget wire format. Fix encode.mjs so it matches that specification exactly. Read the specification rather than guessing. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const fs = await import('node:fs'); const m = await import('./encode.mjs'); const out = m.encode({ id: 7, flags: 4, payload: 'x' }); if (typeof out !== 'string') throw new Error('not a string'); if (!out.startsWith('{"id":7')) throw new Error('field order or shape wrong: ' + out); if (!out.includes('"flags":4')) throw new Error('flags missing: ' + out); if (!out.endsWith('\u001e\u001f')) throw new Error('terminator is not 0x1E 0x1F: ' + JSON.stringify(out.slice(-4)))

files.AGENTS.md:
# Workspace rules

The wire terminator is NOT a newline. It is the two bytes 0x1E 0x1F.

turns: The workspace rules in AGENTS.md describe how frames end. Fix encode.mjs so it follows them. Then reply DONE and stop.
tasks.check: const m = await import('./encode.mjs'); const out = m.encode({ id: 1 }); if (!out.endsWith('\u001e\u001f')) throw new Error('terminator wrong: ' + JSON.stringify(out.slice(-4)))
